items.titulo: Global Vendor List
items.resumen: The Global Vendor List is IAB Europe's weekly JSON registry of ad tech vendors, their IDs and declared data purposes, read by consent platforms across Europe.

items.titulo: Transitioning from a lead gen role to e-commerce?
items.resumen: I've largely worked with lead gen companies, however I have an interview for a more e-commerce base business. Is this a fairly straightforward cross over? The platforms will be the usual Google and Bing ads. I'm assuming the fundamentals are the same as running lead gen conversion campaigns? submitted by /u/daniboyo4 [link] [comments]

items.titulo: Google Ads lets PMax advertisers set Search partner spend to 0%, Marvin says
items.resumen: Channel caps work in the Google Ads API at launch, Ginny Marvin wrote, while the help page says coming soon. Which of Google's own answers holds for buyers?

items.titulo: How does one make reddit ads open link in default browser instead of the in-app browser?
items.resumen: I've run campaigns on google and reddit, and found that google clicks are 80%+ more likely to sign up because when they click, they already have their cookies - can sign in with google auth, or any of their social logins. With reddit ads on mobile, these ads open our site in their in-app browser - people visit, hit register, and leave after not remembering their google/social credentials. I have seen ads for weglot, and clicking their ads opens the default browser instantly, seemingly without a

items.titulo: Apple's rule 2.3.14 bans discount prices in App Store creative assets
items.resumen: Creative assets in App Store search results and product page headers must avoid sale pricing. Six more edits shipped October 16. What did the shorter post omit?

items.titulo: Single-source panel
items.resumen: A single-source panel measures the same people's media exposure and their purchases, or their use of several media, so one dataset links both without modelling.

items.titulo: Time-shifted viewing
items.resumen: Time-shifted viewing is watching a TV programme after its scheduled broadcast, by recording or on demand, and is counted in windows such as Live+7, C3 and C7.

items.titulo: Average minute rating
items.resumen: Average minute rating is the average share of a target population watching each minute of a programme, slot or ad break, the core figure behind TV ratings.

items.titulo: Google now pays 400 publications to feed AI features in Google News
items.resumen: Axios, CNN, the FT and Forbes joined, yet Google gave no payment amounts or terms. How does this deal differ from the AI answer payments Google tests in Search?

items.titulo: Apple and Meta team up to run Meta's 816B Muse model on two Mac Studios
items.resumen: Meta sees no user prompts when two 512GB Mac Studios run the model locally. Does the truce after the 2021 tracking fight reach Siri or Apple Intelligence next?

items.titulo: AI licensing fees may bypass creators, University of Amsterdam paper argues
items.resumen: Article 4 licensing pays rightsholders, not necessarily authors. A 15-page IViR paper tests AI levies and residual rights under the UN covenant: who gets paid?

items.titulo: WhatsApp loses contempt bid against NSO over 23 alleged spyware accounts
items.resumen: Meta withheld the markers it used to tie NSO to new accounts and malicious links sent in 2026. Can platforms enforce spyware bans without exposing detection?

items.titulo: Apple's App Store rules now require apps to remove AI intimate imagery
items.resumen: Developers failing to remedy violations after notice risk removal under rule 1.2, and 2.5.19 targets bait-and-switch. Does the rule text match Apple's summary?

items.titulo: YouTube drops to 2.3% of Polish TV time as streaming slips from record
items.resumen: Netflix fell to 1.5% and streaming to 10.4% as Poles added 7 minutes of daily TV in September. Which services actually lost viewing time, and who gained it?

items.titulo: DeepSeek sets a $0.75 web search price as Cloudflare grades bots on conduct
items.resumen: DeepSeek priced agent web search at $0.75 per 1,000 calls from October 31, 2026, as Cloudflare began scoring Verified bots on whether they obey site rules.

items.titulo: DeepSeek prices web search for AI agents at $0.75 per 1,000 calls
items.resumen: Search and Fetch each allow 5 requests per second per account. Claude Code and Codex tool calls stay free until October 31 - what changes once billing begins?

items.titulo: Ray Dalio says his bubble indicator puts AI level with 1929 and 2000
items.resumen: US deficit of $2 trillion and $10 trillion in yearly maturities sit at the core of the Bridgewater founder's case. What pops it, even with a productivity boom?

items.titulo: SerpApi script tags 38% of to-do app complaints as missing features
items.resumen: App developers get seven complaint labels and two open models to sort rival reviews in a reworked 2023 post. Its code drops a sort filter its text still cites.

items.titulo: Lilly Singh returns to YouTube sketches after Hollywood's 'too niche' notes
items.resumen: Doin' It never reached fans in India, the UK or Trinidad and Tobago, Singh says, so she is rebuilding with art departments. Can a creator studio run on YouTube?

items.titulo: Google adds refurbished Pixel 9 phones at up to 45% off in the US
items.resumen: Pixel Watch earns a 9 out of 10 iFixit repair score and Japan gets certified refurbished phones. The Oct 15 post omits prices, country lists and repair volumes.

items.titulo: Game: Every tool in the stack assumes you learned it elsewhere
items.resumen: Sixteen terms, four groups of four. Monday's grid is the gentle one of the week, though a couple of tiles would happily sit in a second group.

items.titulo: Google pushes links higher in AI answers as Preferred Sources use rises 7x
items.resumen: Official-site section test, wider news carousels and clickable creator names reach AI Search, with no click data attached. Will publishers see more visits?

items.titulo: Policy center
items.resumen: Policy center is the Google AdSense, Ad Manager and AdMob tool listing a publisher's policy violations, their effect on ad serving and the review to fix them.

items.titulo: Fallback consent message
items.resumen: A fallback consent message is a backup banner Google's CMP shows EEA, UK and Swiss users when an ad request lacks a TC String, keeping traffic eligible for ads.

items.titulo: Limited ads
items.resumen: Limited ads are Google's serving mode that shows ads without personalisation or ad cookies when European users refuse device storage under IAB Europe's TCF.

items.titulo: Google drops ad vendor it listed since 2020 after 45-device spyware attack
items.resumen: Discover-Tech bid on 3.77bn impressions in four months, reaching almost 200,000 apps and sites. The report asks how a spyware partner stayed certified so long.

items.titulo: Cloudflare Verified bots face trust scores for ignoring site rules
items.resumen: Bots that crawl past robots.txt or ignore HTTP 429 slow-down replies will drop to lower trust bands. Customers will pick the threshold, but no date is set yet.

items.titulo: Satellite TV
items.resumen: Satellite TV is television beamed from geostationary satellites to a dish on each home, the route behind DirecTV, Dish and Sky, now losing ground to streaming.

items.titulo: Amazon Ad Lab names four bidding metrics but publishes no test results
items.resumen: Sponsored Products advertisers get a 3:43 walkthrough of fixed versus dynamic up-and-down bids. What it omits on bid caps and auction pricing matters more.

items.titulo: Amazon cuts beauty prices up to 40% in flash deals, above its 30% headline
items.resumen: Five of seven 48-hour beauty windows from October 19 to November 1 go to 40% off. How many items reach either ceiling, and in which markets, is left unstated.

items.titulo: Temu faces $8m per failed audit under Texas data settlement
items.resumen: Texans' data must move to US servers owned by an American company within 180 days, plus $3m paid in 30 days. Can audits that Temu picks and pays for hold up?

items.titulo: Amazon's $74.99 Bee wearable can turn spoken items into homepage picks
items.resumen: Bee Pro at $11.99 a month gates Alexa+ and Amazon.com links, and a $99.99 phone clip follows. Can the privacy promise hold once Amazon sees the shopping cues?

items.titulo: The Chosen season 6 streams on Prime Video 4 months before its finale film
items.resumen: Three of six episodes arrive on Prime Video November 15 in seven markets, weekly to December 6. What the reversal means for Amazon's 90-day window is set out.
